QUOTE: **Lazy loading:** `entropic/__init__.py` imports binding symbols lazily (PEP 562), so `entropic install-engine` can run before the `.so` exists.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that lazy imports let `install-engine` run before the engine `.so` exists, which is the substance of the item (import succeeds before the engine is on disk, enabling an in-package install subcommand).
